name: RC Desktop
use_label: GUI for WSL containers on Windows
one_liner: A small Windows app that manages WSL Containers (wslc) like Docker Desktop, in Rust.

text.why: Using WSL containers means typing commands. RC Desktop gives a Docker Desktop-style window, built in Rust with Slint so it starts fast and uses little memory without Electron.
text.take: Built for the author's own use, it stays small and simple.
build: Start, stop, restart and remove containers, view logs and inspect output, and list images, volumes and networks. Deploy via a form, a pasted docker-compose file or a pasted docker run command, with compose stacks started and stopped together.

who.role: Developers using WSL containers on Windows 11.

start.text: Download the Windows build from the repository or project page.

caveat: Windows only; the author says it is early and has rough edges. A brand-new project with 2 stars.

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
